items.title: 1Password Security Incident
items.summary: Password manager 1Password announced that a security incident was detected in its backend systems. It stated that customer vaults were not affected by this situation and remain secure.

snapshot.description: 1Password identified a security incident involving some of our backend systems. Customer vaults were not accessed and remain secure.

items.title: Much shorter version of GRH Lean verification from Anthropic
items.summary: grh-lean, shared by lsernau, presents a shorter verification process for the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis on the mathematical proof software Lean 4. This work introduces a new approach in the field of formal verification of complex mathematical propositions.

snapshot.description: A short Lean 4 proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis - lsernau/grh-lean

items.title: The New York Times warns photographers not to update Photoshop over AI features
items.summary: The New York Times is warning photographers not to update the image editing software Photoshop due to its AI features. The organization expresses concerns about the potential impact of these tools on copyrights and ethical standards.

items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra is the first model to beat Googlers' code golf records
items.summary: GPT-6.2 Astra has become the first AI model to surpass the code golf records of Google employees. This model has reached a new level of success in competitive programming tests that aim to write the shortest possible code sequence.

items.title: GOLD-SLAM: Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM
items.summary: GOLD-SLAM is a Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) system that resolves the discrepancy between the wide field of view of panoramic cameras and the limited data of LiDAR sensors. It combines high-quality rendering with precise geometric reconstruction by performing global tracking and mapping.

snapshot.description: Panoramic cameras capture nearly the entire spherical field of view in a single frame. However, the mismatch between this panoramic coverage and the field of view of LiDAR poses a substantial challenge for panoramic Gaussian splatting SLAM that relies on LiDAR depth priors. We introduce GOLD-SLAM, a Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM system that combines high-quality rendering with accurate geometric reconstruction. items.title: Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face examines the mechanisms affecting the performance of self-evolving agents that autonomously conduct scientific research. The study addresses the contribution of context management and capabilities to system success in long-term experimental processes with a systematic approach.

snapshot.description: Autoresearch agents, which autonomously design, run, and refine experiments, are accelerating scientific progress, particularly in AI research. However, existing agents rely on harnesses that combine multiple mechanisms, making it difficult to determine how individual components contribute to performance. items.title: Efficient Video Retrieval Augmented Generation via Token Allocation
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face introduces a framework called Lembas, developed to reduce the computational load in understanding long videos. This method treats the RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) process—a method that enables AI to generate answers by retrieving information from current and specific data—as a token allocation problem between frames and subtitles.

snapshot.description: Efficient long-video understanding requires identifying relevant evidence while minimizing the tokens processed by vision-language models (VLMs). items.title: Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face discusses AI agents that write code iteratively improving their own implementations. The study proposes an evaluation-free self-improvement process as an alternative to evaluation-based selection methods used to achieve performance gains.

snapshot.description: Recent self-improving coding agents have achieved strong benchmark performance by iteratively modifying their own executable implementations. items.title: Letting Models Manage Their Own Context: Where We Stand
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face examines a new approach where AI models manage their own context. Tested on NVIDIA's open-source agent development tool nooa, this method allows the model to decide for itself which information to summarize via an application programming interface (API).

snapshot.description: Agent harnesses today manage context on the model's behalf: when the window fills, the harness triggers a compaction that summarizes the history. We study the alternative, model-driven context management, in which the model itself decides when and what to compact through a context API.
